title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 with lower agent-workflow costs
friendlyTitle: Anthropic releases a stronger, cheaper Claude model
summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 for general use and the more tightly controlled Mythos 5.1 for vetted cyber and life-science work. The company says lower cache-read pricing cuts typical Fable workloads by about 25% and highly agentic workloads by as much as 45%, while reducing false-positive safety blocks.
friendlySummary: Claude Fable 5.1 is available now. Anthropic says it performs better and can cost less, especially when an AI agent reuses a lot of earlier information.
whyItMatters: For long-running agents, reused context can dominate the bill, so cache pricing may matter as much as headline token prices. Teams should still test the model on their own tasks: the performance and savings figures are vendor-reported and vary by workload.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Businesses may be able to run longer AI tasks for less money. They should test real work before assuming the advertised savings will apply to them.
